description.value: Ignite Pizzeria is a Vancouver-born stone-fired pizza restaurant that opened its Mount Pleasant location in 2017, now the flagship of a growing multi-location chain across Metro Vancouver. Pizzas are hand-tossed with low-sodium dough given a three-day rest before firing at 800°F, with a menu that covers both meat-forward and fully vegan options. The Mount Pleasant location is licensed, making it a sit-down dining option for cyclists coming off the Main Street corridor.
